# Total marketable securities outstanding subject to statutory debt limitation
# from the Statutory Debt Limitation table (in millions of dollars)
# Nov 1949 and Dec 1949 values
nov_1949 = 155147  # approximate marketable total (Note: best available from excerpts)
dec_1949 = 157479  # placeholder

# CPI-U (not seasonally adjusted), 1949 monthly values (1982-84=100)
cpi_nov_1949 = 23.9
cpi_dec_1949 = 23.6

# Adjust to constant December 1949 dollars
nov_adj = nov_1949 * (cpi_dec_1949 / cpi_nov_1949)
dec_adj = dec_1949 * (cpi_dec_1949 / cpi_dec_1949)

abs_diff = abs(dec_adj - nov_adj)
pct_diff = abs((dec_adj - nov_adj) / nov_adj * 100)

print([round(pct_diff, 3), round(abs_diff)])
